youtube_title: Jesus... He Ended Three Years With One Text | Psalm 34:18 #Shorts
youtube_description:
Jesus... he ended three years with one text. "I think we want different things." That's it.

Three years together, ended with one text message. She keeps rereading it, hoping it will say something else.

Her: Jesus... he ended three years with one text. "I think we want different things." That's it. 💔

Her: I keep reading it, like if I read it enough it'll say something else.

Jesus: Put the phone down for a minute. Look at Me instead.

Her: Was I that easy to leave?

Jesus: How he left says something about him. It doesn't decide what you're worth.

Her: Then why do I feel like nothing right now?

Jesus: Because three years don't disappear in one night. The pain is real. So am I, right here, while it hurts.

"The LORD is close to the brokenhearted and saves those who are crushed in spirit."
Psalm 34:18 (NIV)

Jesus: You won't feel like this forever. Tonight, just let Me stay with you.
